svg.title: Solai · Greyscale · Editable mountain, lake and skyline scene
svg.desc: An editable vector reconstruction of the current Solai desktop scene, using the original deterministic ridge silhouettes and five-building skyline. Separate named groups contain the sky, sun, mountains, lake, reflections, shore haze, skyscrapers and individual windows. All artwork uses paths, rectangles, circles and standard gradients. No embedded images, fonts, filters, CSS variables or external assets. The subtle raster grain is intentionally omitted.
